claim: Vera keeps two kinds of memory of you, and both stay on your Mac. (1) The TRANSIENT turn log: every exchange is appended to a short-lived working log (name.chat.jsonl) that the recent-turn context is read back from verbatim, so she remembers what was just said this session. (2) The durable PORTRAIT: a small distilled profile she injects whole into every local/private reply so she simply knows you. The privacy contract is per-turn: her personal memory of you — the Portrait + the LIRF/world-state bundle — is BLANKED to '' before prompt assembly only when the selected backend for that turn is a provider-backed cloud brain; a cloud-capable mouth on a LOCAL route keeps the Portrait local. Private inbox reads still pause when a cloud provider is active, and a never-keyed cloud provider stays local, so the guard can't be tricked into blanking a truly-local session. When she sleeps the working log is distilled into the Portrait and cleared, but ANIMA LAW 001 first APPENDS the raw turns to an append-only chat archive, so nothing the Portrait fails to capture is ever destroyed.
owner: anima/portrait.py (log_turn = append one exchange to the transient working log name.chat.jsonl; read_transcript = the recent-turn context read back verbatim and fed to the mouth; load/save = the durable Portrait name.portrait.md the mouth injects whole; clear_log = LAW-001 archive-then-clear, raw turns appended to name.chat.archive.jsonl BEFORE the log is unlinked; consolidate = the nightly distil-into-Portrait), anima/mouth.py (respond(): mem = portrait.load(heart.name) injected whole, brain = brain_for_route(route_model), then the route privacy gate `if selected brain is cloud: mem = ''` blanks the whole personal-memory bundle before _assemble_prompt), anima/route.py (_cloud_paused — the inbox mirror of the same cloud-pause posture for private host reads), anima/cloud.py (is_cloud = provider!=local AND key present — the active provider gate used by private host-read pause)

killer_test.name: logged_turn_retrievable_and_portrait_blanked_under_cloud_like_the_inbox
killer_test.setup: Hermetic temp store (portrait.STORE redirected by _temp_store; cloud.STORE redirected to the same temp dir by the cert). (A) portrait.log_turn(name, user, reply) appends one exchange to the transient working log; portrait.read_transcript(name) retrieves it verbatim (both the user line and Vera's reply present), a second logged turn is ordered after the first, and a FRESH read_transcript re-read from disk still returns both (the log is durable across reload, not in-memory). (B) portrait.save/load round-trips the durable Portrait text (the prose the mouth injects whole). (C) PRIVACY: replay the EXACT mouth.respond seam — mem = portrait.load(name); selected = Mouth.brain_for_route(route_model); if selected brain is cloud: mem = '' — using the production selector. On a LOCAL route mem CARRIES the Portrait even when the mouth has a cloud default; on a CLOUD route the SAME seam blanks mem to '' (withheld — never streamed to the cloud); route.route(a reminders read) still returns the PAUSED note under an active cloud provider; a never-keyed cloud provider (is_cloud False) does NOT blank — no false withhold. (D) ISOLATION + LAW 001: the transient log path (name.chat.jsonl) is distinct from the durable Portrait path (name.portrait.md); clear_log APPENDS the raw turns to name.chat.archive.jsonl and the archive survives the clear (nothing destroyed). Real .anima byte-unchanged. scripts/certify_portrait_memory.py is the executable form.

known_gaps: The cert replays the mouth's Portrait-blanking seam (mem = portrait.load(name) -> selected = Mouth.brain_for_route(route_model) -> blank only if selected brain is cloud) with the REAL production selector rather than calling mouth.respond() end-to-end, because respond() then invokes the selected brain.reply which this hermetic/offline cert does not run. The safety-critical surface — the transient log round-trip and the deterministic 'Portrait withheld for a cloud-routed turn but retained for a local-routed turn' invariant (and the never-keyed-stays-local guard) — is proven model-free; the full respond() assembly and the live cloud egress are exercised by route-backend and cloud/client certs.

consolidate() distils the working log into the Portrait via the language model (brain.reply) and is therefore not run in this offline cert; the deterministic halves it depends on — read_transcript (its input) and clear_log's LAW-001 archive-then-clear (its durable side effect) — ARE certified here.
